design_decision.baseline_fact: The failed V2 live trace observed ghbdtn plus the committed replacement before the original token returned. Official IBus source queues an engine effect when processing_key_event is true and emits it immediately otherwise. The consecutive legacy signals can therefore split across that boundary: commit reaches GTK before the queued delete.
design_decision.selected_route: For every legacy committed-tail manual toggle with SurroundingText, emit one RequireSurroundingText before mutation. Only the resulting exact SetSurroundingText callback may emit the existing consecutive DeleteSurroundingText then CommitText pair. Keep exact final-snapshot confirmation and layout synchronization downstream.
design_decision.rejected_refresh_route: Requesting surrounding text after delete plus commit cannot repair an already reversed mutation and did not produce another callback in the V2 live proof.
design_decision.rejected_deleted_snapshot_route: Waiting after DeleteSurroundingText would expose a visibly blank token and add a partially applied mutation state.
design_decision.rejected_timing_route: Sleep, debounce, delayed attach, and retry cannot prove which side of the IBus processing_key_event boundary owns either signal.
design_decision.rollback_boundary: Remove only the fresh pre-mutation callback fence and its deterministic tests; installed runtime and immutable failed evidence remain untouched.

consequence_analysis.candidate_and_ranking: No candidate, lattice, ranking, morphology, mapping, or correction decision changes.
consequence_analysis.latency: One existing RequireSurroundingText round trip is added only to explicit legacy committed-tail manual toggles. There is no timer, polling loop, or steady-state printable-key cost.
consequence_analysis.cpu_rss_allocation: One boolean pending owner and an existing snapshot callback are reused; no worker, cache, queue, thread, or unbounded allocation is added.
consequence_analysis.cache_reload_learning: Package, cache, reload, generation, and learning owners are unchanged. Feedback still waits for the exact final visible snapshot.
consequence_analysis.concurrency: The pre-mutation callback is the transport fence. A duplicate or stale callback cannot mutate because pending_manual_toggle is consumed before applying the authorized plan.
consequence_analysis.failure_and_rollback: If no fresh snapshot arrives, no text mutation or layout switch occurs. A mismatching snapshot clears the pending request without mutation. Candidate live-test failure restores the captured desktop and retains evidence.
consequence_analysis.compatibility: Terminal and no-SurroundingText output profiles retain their existing immediate routes. ProcessKeyEvent remains observation-only for legacy Shift and the daemon remains the sole pair detector.
consequence_analysis.maintenance: The repair removes the disproved post-mutation refresh state and reuses the already existing pending-manual-toggle callback owner instead of adding another mutation route.
